text_block_list.text:
Having safely made it through the target 
period up to May of her Classic year, 
Hishi Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer, I somehow made it 
this far. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They really are on another level, aren't 
they? Those Umamusume who bet their entire 
lives on racing.

Even amidst her success, she continued to 
watch her fellow Umamusume from a slight 
distance, as always.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First, our familiar face, Tanino 
Gimlet-chan. She gets scolded a lot for 
breaking fences, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I ended up breaking through that 
'impossible' barrier, and really saw that 
'MC Rotation' all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then there's Symboli Kris S-chan. She's a 
Symboli Umamusume, just like the 
President.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As an international exchange student, she 
always sees through the goals she sets and 
the objectives assigned to her...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Her nickname is the "Professional." A 
professional, huh... That sounds so 
cool...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I mean, my nickname is "Mirako" after all. 
Even my nickname is on another level, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I wonder if this autumn really is 
going to be a showdown between Kris S-chan 
and Gimlet-chan.
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle is going to be there too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Wh-What are you saying? That's a 
pretty harsh joke. I mean, after this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a special world where even more 
is demanded of you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"First is... 'resolve', right? How 
seriously you're running will probably 
show right through."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And then... 'effort'... The regular kind 
of effort I do probably doesn't even 
count, though."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S and Gimlet just keep getting 
stronger. They really are Umamusume from 
another world.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Trainer, are you thinking I'm 
totally pathetic right now?"

—It was the opposite. Hishi Miracle said 
it didn't even count as 'hard work,' 
but...

"That's not true. Even if she was just 
following instructions, she worked just as 
hard as any other Umamusume."

"That is precisely why I made it this far, 
and why I can keep going ahead. And 
yet..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to do my best in my own way 
too. Yeah, yeah...

I had zero awareness that I was working 
just as hard as the other Umamusume. This 
lack of awareness clearly...

It leads to a "lack of confidence." At 
this rate, there's no way I can face the 
competition positively.

To resolve this, it looks like we'll need 
to change our approach. First, starting 
with our policy on race selection.
choice_data_list:
Hishi Miracle, about our next target 
race...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. Shall we continue taking it easy?
choice_data_list: No, let's make a firm decision.
No, let's make a firm decision.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Pulling together"... Wait, it can't be...
choice_data_list: Yeah, a reasonably big target race!

Yeah, let's aim for a pretty big target 
race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh man~, seriously~? I'm kind of feeling 
the pressure~...

It's best to set a clear goal. And then, 
working toward it—

It seemed she wouldn't gain confidence 
unless I made her acutely "aware" of the 
effort she had put in.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, making the decision myself is a 
bit... I don't have the courage or the 
knowledge for that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, just give me something 
reasonable, please~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...!? Trainer-san!? Not there! That's not 
the spot, not there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This stinging stomachache is gonna take me 
down~. Let's do something a bit easier, 
please~.
choice_data_list: Maybe around the GⅡ Kobe Shimbun Hai?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A trial race for the Kikuka Sho, huh? 
Buuut~, then agaaain~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for a graded race is already quite 
a reach, isn't it? There are plenty of 
Umamusume who can't even get that far.

—Reaching above her limits. That very 
tension was exactly what Hishi Miracle 
needed right now.

Preparing to clear a higher bar. Being 
conscious of that thorough preparation is 
what turns into true confidence.
choice_data_list: The Kobe Shimbun Hai... sound good?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...
choice_data_list:
Our goal isn't to win, it's to do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Put that way, I kind of feel 
like I might have a shot...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Am I being tricked? Am I an easy mark, 
maybe? But still~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Working hard for the Kobe 
Shimbun Hai! I can do that much. Let's 
make the goal "working hard"!

Despite grumbling about it, they agreed to 
go along.

The goal is the Kobe Shimbun Hai. Let's 
work on reforming Hishi Miracle's mindset 
leading up to it.
